title: Paramin Heritage & Recreation Tour
summary: An afternoon heritage outing combines the Paramin Rounders Tournament, mountain views and local seasoning stops.
description: The National Trust of Trinidad and Tobago lists this Paramin outing for Sunday, October 18, 2026, from 2:00 PM to 7:00 PM. The programme includes the Paramin Rounders Tournament, Barre la Vigie Lookout, and stops to discover and sample local seasonings and toolum. Tickets are TT$275 for non-members and TT$225 for members; lunch is not included. Contact the organizer to confirm transport, meeting point and availability.
